turns.text: So where are we on, um, the money side—
Sorry, before that, can I ask about the driver app? Does it work offline?
It does, it syncs when they're back in coverage.
Good, that was a blocker for us.
Anyway, on the money, it's sixty— sorry, sixty-five. Sixty-five's what got approved.
Oh, and before I forget, it's Malik's call in the end. He signs.
I'll ask our PM for a few times once the rollout plan is done, and send them over.
